SELECT a.scm11_dev_step_id AS dev_step_id , a.scm11_dev_id AS dev_id , a.scm11_sr_date AS sr_date , a.scm11_system_cd AS system_cd , a.scm11_system_nm AS system_nm , a.scm11_dev_note AS dev_note , a.scm11_dev_person_nm AS dev_person_nm , a.scm11_result_date_str AS result_date_str , a.scm11_deploy_count AS deploy_count , a.scm11_dev_step_result AS dev_step_result , a.scm11_sr_no AS sr_no FROM ( SELECT * , f_cdnm('DevStepCode', scm11_dev_step_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS scm11_dev_step_nm , f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id) AS scm11_dev_step_result , f_emp_kor_nm(scm11_person_id) AS scm11_person_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(scm10_person_id) AS scm11_dev_person_nm , scm01_sr_date AS scm11_sr_date , scm01_sr_no AS scm11_sr_no , scm01_system_cd AS scm11_system_cd , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm01_system_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS scm11_system_nm , scm10_reg_date AS scm11_reg_date , scm10_note AS scm11_dev_note , to_char(scm11_result_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS scm11_result_date_str , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm13_dev_program INNER JOIN scm30_program ON scm13_program_id = scm30_program_id WHERE scm13_dev_id = scm11_dev_id ) AS scm11_deploy_count FROM scm11_dev_step INNER JOIN scm10_dev ON scm11_dev_id = scm10_dev_id INNER JOIN scm01_sr ON scm10_sr_id = scm01_sr_id WHERE f_trunc(scm01_sr_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND COALESCE(scm01_system_cd, '%') LIKE #{systemCode} AND scm11_dev_step_cd IN ('90') AND scm11_person_id = #{personId} AND scm10_dev_id IN ( SELECT scm10_dev_id FROM scm10_dev INNER JOIN scm01_sr ON scm01_sr_id = scm10_sr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM scm13_dev_program INNER JOIN scm30_program ON scm30_program_id = scm13_program_id ) t ON scm13_dev_id = scm10_dev_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(scm10_note, scm30_program_cd, scm30_program_nm, scm01_sr_no)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ) ) a WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.scm11_dev_step_result LIKE a.scm11_dev_step_nm || '대기중'
ORDER BY a.scm11_reg_date DESC, a.scm11_dev_id DESC

SELECT scm13_dev_program_id AS dev_program_id , scm13_dev_id AS dev_id , scm13_program_id AS program_id , scm13_modi_type AS modi_type , scm13_deploy_tgt_yn AS deploy_tgt_yn , scm13_deploy_seq AS deploy_seq , scm13_deploy_yn AS deploy_yn , scm13_deployer_id AS deployer_id , scm13_deploy_date AS deploy_date , scm13_deploy_note AS deploy_note , to_char(scm13_deploy_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS deploy_date_str , scm30_system_cd AS system_cd , scm30_program_type AS program_type , scm30_program_cd AS program_cd , scm30_program_nm AS program_nm , scm30_source AS source , scm30_version AS version , scm30_person_id AS person_id , scm30_reg_date AS reg_date , scm30_note AS note , scm30_use_yn AS use_yn , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm30_system_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS system_nm , f_cdnm('ProgramType', scm30_program_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS program_type_nm , to_char(scm30_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date_str , f_emp_kor_nm(scm30_person_id) AS person_nm FROM scm13_dev_program INNER JOIN scm30_program ON scm13_program_id = scm30_program_id WHERE scm13_dev_id = #{devId} AND scm13_deploy_tgt_yn = 'true' ORDER BY scm13_deploy_seq
